#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;

struct TaskB {
    void solve() {
        int n;
        string str;
        cin >> n;
        getline(cin, str);
        str += '_';
        bool in_par = false, in_word = false;
        int word_cnt = 0, word_len = 0, max_len = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            char c = str[i];
            if (in_word && (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')')) {
                in_word = false;
                if (in_par) {
                    word_cnt++;
                } else if (word_len > max_len) {
                    max_len = word_len;
                }
                if (c == '(') {
                    in_par = true;
                }
                if (c == ')') {
                    in_par = false;
                }
                word_len = 0;
            } else if (!in_word && !(c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')')) {
                in_word = true;
                word_len++;
            } else if (in_word) {
                word_len++;
            } else if (c == '(') {
                in_par = true;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                in_par = false;
            }
        }
        printf("%d %d", max_len, word_cnt);
    }
};

int main() {
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
